skill.name: serp-analysis
skill.description: Analyzes SERP layouts, ranking patterns, search intent, AI Overviews, and snippet opportunities for a target query. Use for SERP analysis, not keyword demand discovery.
skill.summary: Maps search result pages into evidence-based SEO recommendations.
skill.author: aaron-he-zhu

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown code fences, metadata URLs, and documentation links. The confirmed risks are external Python connector commands, optional environment API key use, and a mismatch between declared WebFetch-only tooling and connector-based network behavior.

remediation.suggestion: Replace shell examples with a host-approved structured tool call, or require explicit user confirmation before running the connector scripts.
Update allowed tools and marketplace disclosures to list external command and network connector behavior, or remove the connector instructions.
Document FIRECRAWL_API_KEY use clearly and require opt-in before any connector reads or sends an environment credential.
Replace parent-directory links with packaged reference files or plain names so the skill does not imply access outside its bundle.

semantic_findings.title: Declared Tool Boundary Mismatch
semantic_findings.description: The skill declares allowed-tools: WebFetch, but later instructs users to run Firecrawl and Tavily Python connector commands for live SERP data. This creates a marketplace disclosure gap because users may expect WebFetch-only behavior while the skill can ask for shell-based network connectors.

content.value_statement: Search teams need current SERP evidence before choosing content targets. This skill maps features, ranking patterns, intent, and difficulty into an actionable brief.
actual_capabilities: Maps SERP features including AI Overviews, snippets, PAA, local packs, video packs, and related searches.
Compares top ranking pages by format, freshness, authority, links, and visible ranking patterns.
Scores True Difficulty using weighted factors from the included analysis template.
Labels metrics as Measured, User-provided, Estimated, or N/A.
Produces content requirements, feature strategy, recommended outline, and next steps.
Supports multi-keyword, local, device, historical, and video SERP comparisons.
limitations: Requires live SERP data, screenshots, URLs, or connector access for current results.
Optional Firecrawl and Tavily commands rely on external scripts and services outside this skill folder.
Feature claims still need manual verification because connector results focus on organic listings.
Does not perform keyword demand discovery or search volume estimation.

use_cases.title: Plan a Content Brief
use_cases.description: Turn a target query into intent evidence, ranking requirements, feature targets, and a recommended outline.

use_cases.title: Assess Competitive Difficulty
use_cases.description: Compare top results and decide whether a new, growing, or established site should pursue the query.

use_cases.title: Find SERP Feature Opportunities
use_cases.description: Identify snippet, PAA, video, local, shopping, and AI Overview opportunities from the visible results page.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze One Keyword
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the SERP for "[keyword]" in [country/language] on [device]. Use provided screenshots or URLs if live access is unavailable.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Keyword Variants
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare SERPs for "[keyword 1]", "[keyword 2]", and "[keyword 3]". Summarize intent, difficulty, overlap, and best target.

prompt_templates.title: Find Feature Opportunities
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the SERP for "[keyword]" and identify featured snippet, PAA, AI Overview, video, image, and local opportunities.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Ranking Strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze "[keyword]" for [site stage]. Include evidence labels, True Difficulty, site-stage fit, content requirements, feature strategy, and next steps.

output_examples.input: Analyze the SERP for "how to start a podcast" in the United States on desktop.
output: SERP overview: informational intent, high difficulty, AI Overview, featured snippet, PAA, and video results.
Competitive pattern: top results are long guides from authoritative podcasting or marketing sites.
Recommended action: build a current step-by-step guide, target snippet formatting, and add supporting video content.

output_examples.input: Compare "best CRM software" and "CRM pricing" for a SaaS blog.
output: Intent split: one query favors comparison guides, while the other favors pricing pages and vendor lists.
Difficulty note: enterprise domains dominate both SERPs, so a growing site should target narrower use cases first.
Next step: create a comparison hub, then build supporting pages for industry and company-size modifiers.

output_examples.input: Find AI Overview and snippet opportunities for "email deliverability checklist".
output: Opportunity: use a concise checklist format with direct answers under question-based headings.
Evidence need: verify current AI Overview citations and featured snippet holder before final recommendations.
Content requirement: include diagnostic steps, sender authentication, monitoring, and update cadence.

best_practices: Provide location, language, device, date, and the exact query before analysis starts.
Supply screenshots or top URLs when live fetching is unavailable or restricted.
Separate measured evidence from estimates and mark missing inputs as N/A.
anti_patterns: Do not treat model estimates as measured SERP metrics.
Do not rely on one connector result for feature layout claims.
Do not use this skill for keyword volume discovery.

faq.question: Does this skill fetch live SERP data?
faq.answer: It can use provided SERP evidence or optional connectors. Connector use depends on the host environment and user approval.

faq.question: Can it replace keyword research?
faq.answer: No. It evaluates known queries and should follow keyword discovery work.

faq.question: Does it support AI Overview analysis?
faq.answer: Yes. It checks AI Overview presence, citation patterns, and content structures that may support AI visibility.

faq.question: What inputs produce the best results?
faq.answer: Use the exact keyword, target location, language, device, date, screenshots, and top ranking URLs.

faq.question: Can it compare locations or devices?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes prompts for local variations and mobile versus desktop SERP differences.

faq.question: Does it create final content?
faq.answer: No. It creates SERP evidence and recommendations for a content writer or strategist.
